text:
noora_cs: Heads-up: GreenLoop's CI is failing during our SDK init with a bunch of 429s. They run 30-40 parallel workers in eu-west-1.

rachel_eng: Oof. Any error body? 429 with Retry-After?

noora_cs: They pasted this: `{'error':'rate_limited','retry_after':null}` — no retry header. Happens at preflight/handshake step, before any real requests.

tonY_re: do they use ephemeral tokens or long-lived? also curious about keepAlive and preflightConcurrency.

noora_cs: Quick config they shared:
```
const rw = new Redwood({
  apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY,
  preflightConcurrency: 40,
  keepAlive: false,
  tokenMode: 'ephemeral'
});
```

sam_cs: 40 concurrent preflights + ephemeral tokens = classic auth stampede. We have per-key region limits; if auth cache is cold the validation path can pile up and return 429s without Retry-After in a few edge cases.

priyanka_ce: Is this the cold-auth-cache pattern we saw last quarter? We shipped a mitigation, but CI spikes still catch it.
\naaron_se: Related. On server side the token validation calls upstream and sometimes short-circuit 429s when upstream is under duress. Client-side backoff + serialized warmup usually nails it.

noora_cs: Customer wants a quick unblock plan they can apply in their pipeline.

rachel_eng: Short-term advice I give customers: (1) lower preflightConcurrency to ~6-8, (2) enable keepAlive so connections reuse auth state, (3) run a single warmup preflight before forking parallel jobs, (4) add jittered exponential retries around init.

noora_cs: I'll send those. Can you share a small warmup script and a retry snippet I can paste?

aaron_se: Warmup snippet (Node):
```
// warmup-before-fork.js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, keepAlive: true });
await client.preflight(); // run once, then fork your 30 workers
// spawn workers afterwards
```

rachel_eng: Backoff example (pseudo):
```
await retry(async () => client.preflight(), { retries: 6, minTimeout: 150, factor: 2, jitter: true });
```

sam_cs: Also tell them to drop preflightConcurrency -> 8 and flip keepAlive true. That alone usually cuts the fanout by >80% in CI.

priyanka_ce: I'll build a one-pager with the three mitigation patterns (reduce concurrency + keepAlive, serialized warmup, jittered retries) and attach it to the ticket.

noora_cs: They patched their staging pipeline (warmup + keepAlive + concurrency 8) and reported 92% fewer 429s within 10 minutes.

ops_bot: Incident created: INC-2026-058 - regional preflight cold-cache / ephemeral token stampede. Mitigation guide attached.

priyanka_ce: Filing a product suggestion: Console Quickstart should show a CI warmup snippet and default preflightConcurrency=8 for new orgs, with a tooltip about ephemeral tokens. Tagging product.

sam_cs: Great. I'll follow up on renewal health in 2 weeks and confirm stability; will paste warmup script into support ticket now.

noora_cs: Closing loop with GreenLoop tomorrow. Thanks team :thumbsup:
